ov: Semiaquatic members of the weasel family, with long slim bodies, webbed feet and very dense fur that keeps them warm and buoyant. There are 14 species, living in fresh water and at sea.
rg: Rivers, lakes and coasts across much of the world.
df: Mainly fish, plus frogs, birds or shellfish, depending on the species.
fx: Otters are playful animals, known for sliding into water.
